comment: Performance baselines for regression detection. Times in microseconds (us). Updated by tools/perf-test --update. internal-time-units-per-second = 1000000.

tak.setup: (defun tak (x y z) (if (<= x y) z (tak (tak (- x 1) y z) (tak (- y 1) z x) (tak (- z 1) x y))))

loop_1m.expr: (let ((i 0) (acc 0)) (while (< i 1000000) (setq acc (+ acc i)) (setq i (+ i 1))) acc)

list_build_100k.expr: (let ((l nil) (i 0)) (while (< i 100000) (setq l (cons i l)) (setq i (+ i 1))) (length l))

gcd_100k.expr: (let ((i 0) (sum 0)) (while (< i 100000) (setq sum (+ sum (gcd (+ i 17) (+ i 31)))) (setq i (+ i 1))) sum)

setup: (defun nq-safe (q cols) (if (null cols) t (let ((c (car cols)) (d (length cols))) (and (not (= q c)) (not (= q (+ c d))) (not (= q (- c d))) (nq-safe q (cdr cols))))))
(defun nq-solve (n cols) (if (= (length cols) n) 1 (let ((count 0)) (dotimes (q n count) (when (nq-safe q cols) (setq count (+ count (nq-solve n (cons q cols)))))))))
